verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's results docs describe both a Bayesian and a Frequentist engine, including 'Chance to Win' interpretation. Its GitHub README lists a stats engine with CUPED and post-stratification (variance reduction), plus sequential testing and SRM checks. Some community commenters wanted more detail on early stopping, but that is skepticism, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the CUPED/post-stratification configuration (only a README bullet is in evidence), independent hands-on corroboration of the statistical methodology.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
